examen.title: Competency Exam
examen.subtitle: Take this 16-question assessment to identify your key skills and further complete your resume.
examen.result_tip: Excellent! Now that you know your main strengths, integrate them into the description of the work experiences where you put them into practice.
examen.toast_new_set: We loaded a new set of 16 questions.
examen.toast_no_questions: No questions available for this exam.
examen.toast_answer_all: You must answer all questions before submitting the exam.
examen.exam_q01: An urgent project has a critical error just before delivery.
examen.exam_q01_a: Make the necessary adjustments to meet the delivery deadline.
examen.exam_q01_b: Review the root cause of the error to prevent it from happening again.
examen.exam_q01_c: Coordinate with the team to solve it in the best possible way.
examen.exam_q02: You are assigned a completely new task.
examen.exam_q02_a: Explore resources and learn what's needed on your own.
examen.exam_q02_b: Structure a clear plan before starting to execute.
examen.exam_q02_c: Propose a different approach to tackle the task.
examen.exam_q03: A colleague is delaying part of the work.
examen.exam_q03_a: Talk directly to understand the situation.
examen.exam_q03_b: Ensure the project progress is not compromised.
examen.exam_q03_c: Support them so the team keeps its momentum.
examen.exam_q04: A client requests a difficult change in a short time.
examen.exam_q04_a: Propose a viable solution within the deadline.
examen.exam_q04_b: Explore tools or methods that speed up the process.
examen.exam_q04_c: Reorganize priorities to try to deliver.
examen.exam_q05: The work environment is tense due to pressure.
examen.exam_q05_a: Stay focused on objectives despite the environment.
examen.exam_q05_b: Create a brief space to align the team.
examen.exam_q05_c: Identify what is generating the tension.
examen.exam_q06: You detect an error in your work before it escalates.
examen.exam_q06_a: Handle it quickly to minimize impact.
examen.exam_q06_b: Report it along with a possible solution.
examen.exam_q06_c: Document what happened to improve processes.
examen.exam_q07: You are asked to lead a new initiative.
examen.exam_q07_a: Define objectives and coordinate the team.
examen.exam_q07_c: Design an innovative way to execute it.
examen.exam_q08: You must choose between two suppliers.
examen.exam_q08_b: Evaluate compliance with standards and criteria.
examen.exam_q08_c: Opt for a more innovative solution.
examen.exam_q09: A meeting loses its initial focus.
examen.exam_q09_a: Redirect the conversation towards the objectives.
examen.exam_q09_b: Listen to understand the underlying problem.
examen.exam_q10: You are asked to collaborate on something outside your role.
examen.exam_q10_a: Help if it contributes to the overall objective.
examen.exam_q10_b: Take the opportunity to develop new skills.
examen.exam_q10_c: Clarify the scope of your responsibilities.
examen.exam_q11: You receive feedback you don't fully agree with.
examen.exam_q11_a: Respond with clear and respectful arguments.
examen.exam_q11_b: Objectively evaluate if you can improve something.
examen.exam_q11_c: Adjust your approach to avoid future friction.
examen.exam_q12: You need to reduce costs in a project.
examen.exam_q12_c: Make decisions aligned with the team.
examen.exam_q13: You must organize an activity with little time.
examen.exam_q13_a: Prioritize the essentials to meet the objective.
examen.exam_q14: Someone asks you for help making an important decision.
examen.exam_q15: An external situation interrupts your work.
examen.exam_q15_b: Inform those involved about the change.
examen.exam_q15_c: Reorganize tasks to make the most of the time.
examen.exam_q16: You need to achieve an important personal goal.
examen.exam_q16_b: Analyze your current situation before acting.
examen.exam_q16_c: Explore new ways to achieve it.
examen.exam_q17: You face a new situation in your environment.
examen.exam_q17_a: Organize what you need to solve first.
examen.exam_q17_c: Involve others to facilitate the process.
examen.exam_q18: A conflict arises with another person.
examen.exam_q18_c: Find a middle ground that benefits both.
examen.exam_q19: You want to develop a new skill.
examen.exam_q19_c: Try different methods until finding the ideal one.
examen.exam_q20: You must coordinate an event with multiple variables.
examen.exam_q22: You find something important that isn't yours.
examen.exam_q22_a: Try to locate the owner directly.
examen.exam_q22_b: Think about where they could recover it most easily.
examen.exam_q22_c: Take it to a formal delivery point.
examen.exam_q23: An unexpected event affects your punctuality.
examen.exam_q23_b: Look for alternatives to reduce the delay.
examen.exam_q23_c: Make the most of the available time in another way.
examen.exam_q24: A group you're part of isn't achieving good results.
examen.exam_q24_b: Maintain the group's morale and cohesion.
examen.exam_q25: You have to make an important decision with incomplete information.
examen.exam_q25_a: Make a decision based on the best available information.
examen.exam_q26: An unexpected problem blocks your progress.
examen.exam_q27: No one is taking initiative on a project.
examen.exam_q27_a: Take the first step without being asked.
examen.exam_q27_b: Organize the team to get started.
examen.exam_q27_c: Define a clear direction before acting.
examen.exam_q28: You need to learn something new in a short time.
examen.exam_q28_c: Look for shortcuts or efficient resources.
examen.exam_q29_a: Find common ground to move forward.
examen.exam_q29_c: Hold firm on the main objective.
examen.exam_q30: You need to review work before submitting it.
examen.exam_q30_b: Ensure it meets the main objective.
examen.exam_q30_c: Optimize it if you find improvements.
examen.exam_q31: You need to plan something long-term.
examen.exam_q31_b: Break it down into concrete steps.
examen.exam_q32: Work starts piling up and you feel pressure.
examen.exam_q33: You're assigned to lead a project with unclear objectives.
examen.exam_q33_a: Define a clear direction before moving forward.
examen.exam_q33_b: Gather the team to align expectations.
examen.exam_q33_c: Make quick decisions to generate traction.
examen.exam_q34: You notice a process can be significantly improved.
examen.exam_q34_c: Analyze the impact before changing it.
examen.exam_q35: You receive multiple important requests at the same time and context changes during the day.
examen.exam_q35_c: Adapt quickly to new conditions without slowing progress.
examen.exam_q36: A client is not satisfied with the result.
examen.exam_q37: You must work with someone you disagree with.
examen.exam_q37_a: Find common ground to collaborate better.
examen.exam_q37_b: Maintain a professional and responsible approach.
examen.exam_q37_c: Adapt to their style to ease collaboration.
examen.exam_q38: You need to learn a complex tool quickly.
examen.exam_q38_c: Analyze how it integrates into the workflow.
examen.exam_q39: A small error could have big consequences.
examen.exam_q40: You must present an idea to people with different interests.
examen.exam_q40_b: Structure it with a broader impact vision.
examen.exam_q40_c: Convince with solid arguments to gain support.
examen.exam_q41: Your team can't meet the objectives.
examen.exam_q41_c: Adjust the plan to unblock progress.
examen.exam_q42: You must choose between a quick solution and a more sustainable long-term one.
examen.exam_q42_a: Prioritize the one that best meets the immediate goal.
examen.exam_q42_b: Make the decision by evaluating risks and trade-offs.
examen.exam_q42_c: Choose the alternative with the best future projection.
examen.exam_q43_c: Adapt quickly to the change to seize it.
examen.exam_q44_a: Try to automate or redesign it.
examen.exam_q45: During a meeting, your proposal is publicly questioned.
examen.exam_q45_a: Respond with clear and respectful arguments.
examen.exam_q45_b: Maintain composure while managing the tension.
examen.exam_q45_c: Reformulate the idea to regain group support.
examen.exam_q46: A key metric drops unexpectedly and no one knows why.
examen.exam_q46_a: Investigate the root cause before intervening.
examen.exam_q46_b: Try specific adjustments to recover the result.
examen.exam_q46_c: Prioritize the action with the greatest immediate impact.
examen.exam_q47: You need to coordinate people with different roles.
examen.exam_q48_b: Act with what's available without getting blocked.
examen.exam_q48_c: Make a clear decision to move forward.
